candidates.change_summary: Replace assignment to betLimit with assignment to betLimit plus the provided amount (so AdjustBetAmounts(amount) increments instead of setting).
Replace assignment to betLimit with assignment to amount divided by two (so AdjustBetAmounts sets betLimit to half the provided amount).
Relax onlyOwner modifier to allow any caller by removing the require check (so AdjustBetAmounts can be called by non-owners and may change betLimit).
Replace assignment to difficulty with assignment that doubles the provided amount, so stored difficulty differs after AdjustDifficulty(...).
Replace assignment to difficulty with no-op (remove assignment), leaving difficulty unchanged after the call (observable difference if caller expected change).
Change onlyOwner modifier to check msg.sender != owner (inverted), allowing non-owner to call AdjustDifficulty and causing different difficulty when called by non-owner.
Assign difficulty to amount + 1 (off-by-one), changing stored difficulty value after AdjustDifficulty(...).
Remove the onlyOwner access check by deleting the modifier invocation so anyone can call OpenToThePublic(), changing openToPublic after call by non-owner accounts.

Weaken the onlyOwner modifier to allow any caller (remove require), so after owner-only functions use this modifier they no longer restrict to owner — this changes OpenToThePublic() behavior when it relies on onlyOwner (via the modifier).
Change OpenToThePublic to set openToPublic = false instead of true so calling the function flips behavior (call results in closed state).
